item: Theoria.md:373 (主终点限三个) x Theoria.md:379 (逐字对照) -- the three endpoints' wording, held in two files that must agree
not_edited: freeze/verify.sh -- other subagents are in this worktree; RES-1 does all wiring
freeze/STATS_RULES.md, freeze/CLAIMS_TEXT.md -- read-only to this run; every proposed fix is a quoted snippet, not an edit

findings.divergences: 13 ranked (D1..D13); 11 are hard, i.e. they change which number gets published
findings.worst: endpoint 2 (adjudication-question accuracy) states no denominator and no clean-tier replication in EITHER file; CLAIMS_TEXT.md C4 contains no 19, no 12, no claim/clean tier at all
findings.fourth_endpoint: CLAIMS_TEXT.md:160-162 makes `theoria - ablation` a conjunct of C2's 成立版 while STATS_RULES.md:380-383 leaves it needs_human/exploratory (§9.8) -- family would be 4, breaking Theoria.md:373
findings.arithmetic: the clean-tier replication of endpoint 2 needs >=7 pairs to reach Holm-adjusted alpha (2*0.5^7=0.0156<0.0167); clean games in the frozen codepoint prefix are 2 at m=5, 4 at m=10, 5 at m=12, 7 only at m=14, so <m> >= 14 is an unstated precondition
findings.rule_vs_code: STATS_RULES.md:265 pre-registers 弃权计错; exam/grading/mark.py:125-130 and :167-168 keep abstentions OUT of both denominators and exam/DECISIONS.md D-EX-015 records that as the right call -- the seal on 只答有把握的题 has no implementation
findings.no_total_order: exam/grading/mark.py:155-156 returns None for an empty denominator, so an all-abstain arm has specificity None, and None is not < <S_min>: the one-vote veto cannot fire
findings.scalar_cannot_discriminate: exam/STATUS.md:53-56 and exam/DECISIONS.md:371-374 -- memoriser and cheater-v4 report the pooled pair 1.000/1.000, identical to ground truth, so BA = 1.000; the drafts pin only `bluffer` as the mandatory negative control and never name `memoriser`
findings.most_gameable: endpoint 2, because it is the only one of the three that can be computed end to end today, its one-vote veto has neither a value nor an aggregation level nor a total order, and its sample size <m> is still open
findings.cheapest_rescue: abstain on the class (iii) items you are unsure of -- the named implementation drops them from the specificity denominator; cost zero, no number changed and no word re-read

negative_controls.mutation: CLAIMS_TEXT.md BA formula (灵敏度 + 特异度)/2 -> /3

gate_result.caveat: control 2's mutation is also caught by stage [8] (its DETECT branch /21([^0-9]|$) matches /21⟩, verified); what stage [8] cannot see is an ABSENT denominator, which is what E2/unit and E2/tier are

why: verify.sh stage 10 exists because one criterion of one endpoint diverged between the two files: adjudicate by the whitelist, publish by the empty set. This run asks what else is in that shape and finds eleven more, then proposes the generalised gate with a firing negative control.
zero_api: no network call, no billed action, no dollar; no sealed-pile game played, inspected or read about -- only claim_set.json ids and counts.
